frozen_thresholds.source: Unchanged minima frozen from the original four consumed positives before both open-set and cross-collection panels.
frozen_thresholds.rule: Emit SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY candidate only when the sequence aggregate has unique top-1 and meets both score and margin thresholds; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
frozen_thresholds.no_adaptation: No frame, crop, reference, feature weight, sequence length, top-two aggregation, threshold, or roster may change after either temporal result is observed.

claim_boundary.allowed: Consumed posthoc Development evidence for or against a fixed reciprocal three-frame, top-two-mean query aggregation mechanism on exactly FP01 and FP02 in the six-target same-provider closed roster.
not_allowed: trained sequential descriptor performance or attribution to SeqNet, SeqVLAD, or JIST
provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, or deployment generalization
exact physical identity authority, pixel portal grounding, entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety
